CustomField.description: This fields is used on approval email templates to show the discount percentage of a product regardless of its usage or rate type.
CustomField.formula: IF( IF( NOT(ISBLANK(Usage_Rate_Discount__c)), Usage_Rate_Discount__c, IF(SBQQ__TotalDiscountRate__c = 0, null, SBQQ__TotalDiscountRate__c) ) > 0, IF( NOT(ISBLANK(Usage_Rate_Discount__c)), Usage_Rate_Discount__c, IF(SBQQ__TotalDiscountRate__c = 0, null, SBQQ__TotalDiscountRate__c) ), null )
CustomField.label: Applied Discount
